top5.title: Single Storage Beds
top5.seoTitle: Single Storage Beds 3ft | Ottoman & Drawer Beds | Eagle Bed
top5.seoDescription: Handmade single storage beds in 3ft: gas lift ottomans and drawer divans, upholstered in Dewsbury. Free delivery across Great Britain, 14-day free returns.
top5.descriptionHtml:
Looking for a single storage bed that frees up space in a small bedroom? Every bed on this page comes in Single 3ft, which takes a standard UK single mattress of 90 x 190cm, and each one has storage built into the base.

There are two kinds. Gas lift ottoman beds raise the whole mattress platform on hydraulic struts to open one large compartment underneath: choose end lift if you have clear floor at the foot of the bed, or side lift if the foot of the bed sits against a wall. Divan storage beds have pull-out drawers instead, so there is no lifting, but leave at least 60cm of clear floor on the drawer side.

Each bed is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop. Most designs can be upholstered in solid colours, stripes or two-tone, and free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually in 3–5 working days.

faqs.q: What size is a single storage bed?
faqs.a: Single is 3ft wide and takes a standard UK single mattress of 90 x 190cm. Every bed on this page is available in that size.

faqs.q: Ottoman or drawers: which is better for a single bed?
faqs.a: A gas lift ottoman lifts the whole mattress platform and gives the most storage, but it needs clear height above the bed. Drawers need no lifting and suit rooms with a sloping ceiling or a shelf over the bed, but need about 60cm of clear floor in front of them.

faqs.q: How much is delivery?
faqs.a: Delivery is free across England, Scotland and Wales by our own team, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man are £90.

faqs.q: Can I return a storage bed?
faqs.a: Yes. You have 14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Every bed frame also has a 5-year warranty.

top5.title: Double Storage Beds
top5.seoTitle: Double Storage Beds 4ft6 | Ottoman & Drawer Beds | Eagle Bed
top5.seoDescription: Double storage beds in 4ft6, handmade in Dewsbury: gas lift ottoman beds and divans with drawers. Free GB delivery and a 5-year frame warranty.
top5.descriptionHtml:
A double storage bed keeps spare bedding, towels and out-of-season clothes under the bed instead of in the wardrobe. Every bed here is offered in Standard Double 4ft6, the size that takes a UK double mattress of 135 x 190cm. If your room is tight, the same designs also come in Small Double 4ft.

Pick a gas lift ottoman for the biggest storage space: the full mattress platform rises on hydraulic struts and opens from the end or, on our side lift models, from the side. Pick a divan with drawers if there is a low window, a sloping ceiling or a shelf above the bed, because drawers pull out rather than lift up.

Every bed is made to order and upholstered by hand in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Most designs can be upholstered in solid colours, stripes or two-tone, and free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home. Pay by card, PayPal, Klarna or Clearpay, with free delivery across Great Britain.

faqs.q: Is a double storage bed 4ft6?
faqs.a: Yes. A standard UK double is 4ft6 and takes a 135 x 190cm mattress. A small double is 4ft (120 x 190cm). Our bed sizes guide explains the difference.

faqs.q: Does an ottoman bed need space above it?
faqs.a: Yes. The whole platform swings up, so check that nothing fixed above the bed, such as a shelf or a low window, stops it opening fully. Drawer beds do not need this clearance.

faqs.q: Can I see the fabric before I order?
faqs.a: Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check the colour and feel at home before you choose.

faqs.q: What warranty do you give?
faqs.a: Every bed frame has a 5-year warranty, and you have 14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

top5.title: Small Double Storage Beds
top5.seoTitle: Small Double Storage Beds 4ft | Handmade | Eagle Bed
top5.seoDescription: Small double storage beds in 4ft: side lift and end lift ottomans plus drawer divans, handmade in Dewsbury. Free delivery across Great Britain.
top5.descriptionHtml:
A small double storage bed suits a box room, a guest room or a first flat. At 4ft wide it takes a 120 x 190cm mattress, 15cm narrower than a standard double, and the space underneath can do the job of a chest of drawers.

Every bed on this page comes in Small Double 4ft. Our side lift ottomans open from the side, so the bed can sit foot-to-wall in a narrow room and still open fully; leave about 60cm of walking space down one side. End-opening ottomans need clear floor at the foot instead. Prefer not to lift anything? The drawer divans let you open one drawer at a time.

Only want lift-up storage? See our small double ottoman beds. Every bed is handmade to order in Dewsbury, with free delivery across Great Britain by our own team, usually in 3–5 working days.

faqs.q: What size is a small double bed?
faqs.a: A small double is 4ft wide and takes a standard UK small double mattress of 120 x 190cm. A standard double is 4ft6 (135 x 190cm).

faqs.q: Will a storage bed fit in a box room?
faqs.a: Measure first. A side lift ottoman can sit with its foot against a wall but needs about 60cm of walking space on one side. A drawer bed needs about 60cm of clear floor on the drawer side.

faqs.q: Do the beds take a standard mattress?
faqs.a: Yes. Each base takes a standard UK mattress in the size you order, and our mattresses come in Small Double 4ft too.

faqs.q: Can I spread the cost?
faqs.a: Yes, with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. You can also pay by card or PayPal.

top5.title: Kids Single Beds
top5.seoTitle: Kids Single Beds 3ft | Upholstered Kids Beds | Eagle Bed
top5.seoDescription: Upholstered kids single beds in 3ft, handmade to order in Dewsbury. Padded headboards, free fabric swatches and free delivery across Great Britain.
top5.descriptionHtml:
Our kids single beds are fully upholstered children's beds, handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop. Every bed on this page comes in Single 3ft, which takes a standard UK single mattress of 90 x 190cm. Each design is also offered in Kids Single 2'6 for a smaller room and Small Double 4ft for more space.

The padded headboards are upholstered by hand over a solid frame, in styles from a classic buttoned panel to clean lines and soft wingbacks. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour, and order free swatches to check the colour at home first.

Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually in 3–5 working days, and you have 14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Questions about sizes? Call us on 07417 439197, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm.

faqs.q: What sizes do your kids beds come in?
faqs.a: Kids Single 2'6, Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft. This page shows the Single 3ft option, which takes a 90 x 190cm mattress.

faqs.q: Can I choose the colour?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free fabric swatches are available.

faqs.q: Do you sell a mattress to fit?
faqs.a: Yes. Our mattresses come in Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft, so order the size that matches the bed.

faqs.q: How long does delivery take?
faqs.a: Usually 3–5 working days by our own team. Delivery is free across England, Scotland and Wales; Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man are £90.

top5.title: Double Divan Beds
top5.seoTitle: Double Divan Beds 4ft6 | Upholstered Divans | Eagle Bed
top5.seoDescription: Upholstered double divan beds in 4ft6: platform, drawer and gas lift ottoman divans, handmade in Dewsbury. Free GB delivery and a 5-year frame warranty.
top5.descriptionHtml:
A divan is an upholstered box base that supports your mattress across its whole top, and every divan on this page comes in Standard Double 4ft6 for a 135 x 190cm mattress.

There are three kinds of base. Platform divans have a firm top and no built-in storage, for the simplest look. Drawer divans add pull-out drawers in the base, so you can reach bedding without lifting anything. Ottoman divans raise the whole mattress platform on hydraulic gas struts and give the most storage of the three. Some beds are complete sets with a matching upholstered headboard; the plain bases can be paired with one of our headboards.

Every divan is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop. Most designs can be upholstered in solid colours, stripes or two-tone, and free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home. Delivery is free across Great Britain, usually within 3–5 working days, and every bed frame has a 5-year warranty.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a divan and an ottoman bed?
faqs.a: A divan is an upholstered box base, either with drawers or with no storage. An ottoman is a divan whose whole mattress platform lifts on gas struts, opening the full footprint of the bed as storage.

faqs.q: What size is a double divan?
faqs.a: A standard double divan is 4ft6 and takes a UK double mattress of 135 x 190cm.

faqs.q: Does a divan come with a headboard?
faqs.a: Some of our divans are complete sets with a matching upholstered headboard; the plain bases can be paired with one of our headboards. Each product page says what is included.

faqs.q: How do returns work?
faqs.a: You have 14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging, and we collect it. Every bed frame has a 5-year warranty.
